requirements.ruleText: Hold a high-school diploma or an equivalent or higher qualification.
Be 18 to 55 years old; applicants under 18 require university approval and notarized guardian documents.

Be a non-Chinese citizen holding an ordinary foreign passport and meet the applicable nationality and overseas-residence rules for applicants with Chinese-parent or former Chinese-resident connections.
Submit the application by June 30, 2026. This is a closed historical intake.
Submit the passport information page.
Submit the high-school diploma and complete transcripts for every semester; expected graduates may submit a pre-graduation certificate but must provide the formal diploma before enrollment.
Submit the applicable HSK certificate and any program-specific foreign-language evidence.

references.locator: Section 3, item 3 and Section 4 program table

requirements.ruleText: Submit a valid CSCA score report for the exact subjects assigned to the program.
Submit a recommendation letter in Chinese or English, signed by the recommender and carrying valid contact details.
Pay the non-refundable CNY 800 application fee through the online application system.
Submit the guarantor's valid identity document; a foreign guarantor in China must also provide a valid Chinese visa.
Submit a personal identification photo.
Submit a no-criminal-record certificate.

requirements.appliesTo: Applicants to programs requesting additional evidence
requirements.ruleText: Submit any other material required by the selected program.
Apply through the BLCU international-student application system, upload the electronic materials, monitor telephone and email contact, and provide an accurate admission-document delivery address.

The BLCU Beijing Government Scholarship may cover first-year tuition for approved bachelor, master or doctoral applicants; the published Fall 2026 scholarship deadline is July 15, 2026 and selection is separate from admission.
